product_one_liner.value: Vectary is an online design platform for designers and creative teams to develop concepts with AI and create interactive 3D presentations and AR experiences that are easy to understand and share.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn lists an official count of 18 (11-20); Built In separately reports 33 total employees, so public headcount estimates conflict.

hq_location.notes: Vectary's LinkedIn company profile identifies its headquarters as Redwood City, California.

eng_blog.notes: The blog material located is product updates and user how-tos; I found no evidence of at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public help center links to multiple documentation articles and tutorials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: TheJobsMap reports no open Vectary roles as of November 9, 2026; Wellfound likewise shows no jobs added.

model_provider.value: Vectary's image-to-3D documentation lists Hunyuan 3.1 and 3, Tripo H3.1 and 2.5, Pixal 3D, Trellis 2 and Trellis, Meshy 6 and 5, and Rodin 2.
model_provider.notes: These are the model names Vectary publicly identifies as available; it does not identify a single exclusive provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names GDPR among its compliance standards, although GDPR is not itself a certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was a $4.6 million Series A in January 2023, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No open Vectary roles were listed as of November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: Vectary Canvas launched October 15, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A profile records a Vectary Chief Revenue Officer role ending in May 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations page lists productivity, web, presentation, creative, and communication tools, but no CRM or sales/marketing system.
